title: Neoti
desc: Umanath and Sashinath are stepbrothers who have different personalities and perspectives on life. Haranath, a priest, instigates hatred in their families to fulfil his personal evil agenda.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Antaranga
desc: Parna, the daughter of a rich tea-estate owner, falls for the son of her father's employee, Rana. Their relationship irks Vijay, another employee who wishes to take over the business by marrying her.

title: Porinaam
desc: Raghu falls in love with Nisha, but her father opposes their union. To gain his approval, Raghu decides to enter her house disguised as a servant.

title: Asha O Bhalo Basha
desc: Bijoy is jailed after being framed by Bilas Dutta, a famous businessman, and unable to deal with it, his sister commits suicide. When he is released from prison, Bijoy vows to seek revenge.

title: Baba Keno Chakar
desc: When Rajnarayan asks his son to help out with the expenses for his sister's wedding, he refuses. As a result, he is forced to go from pillar to post to make ends meet.

title: Ajana Path
desc: When a tea estate owner's son falls in love with one of the labourers, he tries to separate them but his son dies. Years later, the owner's grandson Bikram returns, unaware of his family roots.
